from.tooltip:
Combines everything into the one thing the dashboard and the reports both read from.

I have drawn this as a single fan-out point. If the reports are built from something different than the dashboard, this box is a lie.

to.author: agent
to.tooltip:
Combines everything into the one thing the dashboard and the reports both read from.

**Not drawn, but real:** a fifth source, the **Macro Calendar** (Fed dates, CPI prints), is still wired in as a config option and fed straight into this box, bypassing the Cutoff and enrichment. It is **off by default** as of Aug 2026 — mostly noise outside Fed weeks — and deliberately left off this drawing to keep the flow readable.

If someone re-ticks it on the console, this is where it lands.
